card.name: IL at start of drug or term
card.fires_on: The letters "IL" (or a hyphen after IFN beta) starting a drug name or abbreviation in drug labels. Seen in ILARIS, ILUVIEN, IL-1 blockers, and ILD.

modes.label: Brand names starting IL
modes.description: IL begins a brand name such as ILARIS or ILUVIEN right after "dose of".
modes.example: there should be an interval of at least 12 weeks before a new dose of<< IL>>ARIS may be administered.

modes.label: Interleukin abbreviation
modes.description: IL begins an interleukin term like IL-1 or IL-1R antagonists in lists of biologic drugs.
modes.example: 7 DRUG INTERACTIONS 7.1 TNF-Blocking Agent and<< IL>>-1 Blocking Agent Specific drug interaction studies

modes.label: ILD abbreviation
modes.description: IL begins the abbreviation ILD (interstitial lung disease) next to pneumonitis.
modes.example: Withhold AUGTYRO if<< IL>>D/pneumonitis is suspected

card.plain: It fires on the opening letters IL of drug names and terms such as ILARIS or IL-1.
